autoContext: Validates loop action. Covers: file param (iteration sub-workflow), iterations param (max count), continueKey param (stops early when value is falsy: NO/false/done/stop/0/''), outputKey param (value accumulated from each iteration into history), and the 'iteration' variable auto-injected into each iteration seed.

test_early_stop._comment: PARAM: file — iteration sub-workflow JSON. PARAM: continueKey — key in iteration result; when value is 'NO', 'false', 'done', 'stop', '0', or empty, loop stops early. PARAM: outputKey — key accumulated into loop history and returned as final data.

test_fixed_iterations._comment: PARAM: iterations — hard cap on number of iterations (1-10000). When continueKey is absent, loop always runs to this limit. Here set to 2.

verify._comment: Loop stores last iteration's outputKey value under action id. Confirm it is in previous_data.
